categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Tloong Technology Group operates primarily in three segments: internet marketing services, fine chemical products manufacturing (including forest chemical products), and ink chemical products. The internet marketing segment offers performance marketing and brand marketing services leveraging a comprehensive media resource matrix and AI-driven content creation. The fine chemical segment focuses on deep processing of rosin and turpentine products used in plastics, tires, pharmaceuticals, and fine chemicals. The ink chemical segment develops and sells environmentally friendly inks, including water-based and solvent-based inks, serving packaging and printing industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced AI technologies, including a proprietary AIGC engine for automated content creation in marketing. In chemical production, it employs mature deep processing technologies for rosin and turpentine derivatives, with innovations in catalyst preparation and hydrogenation processes. The ink segment uses automated production lines with strict quality control and has developed proprietary acrylic resin materials to reduce import dependence. The company also integrates digital platforms for marketing automation and data-driven campaign optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major internet platforms (e.g., Huawei, Xiaomi, Tencent, Baidu), leading brands in automotive, fast-moving consumer goods, e-commerce, and packaging sectors. The internet marketing services cater to industries such as network services, gaming, finance, automotive, software, and tourism. The ink products serve packaging printing companies for food, daily necessities, pharmaceuticals, and building materials. The forest chemical products target ABS plastics, automotive tires, pharmaceuticals, and fine chemical markets domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic revenue, while also expanding its presence in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, and other emerging markets. Export markets include Vietnam, Singapore, Pakistan, Egypt, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand, Ethiopia, Cambodia, and El Salvador. The company plans to establish overseas production bases, starting with Indonesia, to support global expansion of its ink business.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Tloong operates across upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain. In fine chemicals, it controls raw material sourcing from pine resin and turpentine-rich regions and processes these into intermediate and high-value products. In inks, it manufactures finished products and key raw materials like acrylic resins. In internet marketing, it acts as a midstream service provider, managing media buying, content creation, and campaign execution between media platforms and end clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation in internet marketing, focusing on automated content generation, intelligent media buying, and digital operation platforms. In chemical segments, R&D targets high-value product development such as food-contact water-based inks, advanced rosin derivatives, and environmentally friendly materials. Strategic initiatives include globalizing the ink business with overseas production, extending the forest chemical product chain, and enhancing digital marketing capabilities through AI and big data analytics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from internet marketing campaigns based on performance and brand marketing contracts, product sales of fine chemical and ink products, and licensing of proprietary technologies. The internet marketing segment includes pay-per-click and display advertising revenues, as well as fees for software and marketing services. The chemical segments earn revenue from direct product sales domestically and internationally, including export sales under FOB/CIF terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in liquid ink production and internet marketing services, with recognized brand strength and technological capabilities. It competes with both domestic and international ink manufacturers, especially in the food packaging ink segment where it has broken foreign monopolies. In internet marketing, it holds strategic partnerships with major media platforms and competes by integrating AI and data-driven marketing solutions. The company is recognized as a top-tier enterprise in the Chinese ink industry and a significant player in digital marketing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Guangdong Tloong reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.28 billion, with internet marketing accounting for about 82% of total revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 65.17 million, a significant increase of 378.61% year-over-year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.27 billion, showing a 12.44% increase from the previous year. Despite a revenue decline compared to 2023, profitability and operational efficiency improved markedly, reflecting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated 'technology + data + content' marketing system powered by proprietary AI tools to deliver full lifecycle marketing solutions. In chemical products, it differentiates through high-quality, environmentally friendly inks and advanced rosin derivatives with stable supply chains and mature production processes. Its ink products meet stringent international standards, including food safety certifications, enabling it to serve premium clients like McDonald's globally. The company’s scale, innovation capabilities, and strategic media partnerships provide competitive advantages in both marketing and chemical sectors.
